correctness.rationale: The proof reduces each fixed-\(\beta\) constraint to an exact two-by-two determinant condition, solves the weighted slack problem sharply by \(\operatorname{Tr}(WX)\ge 2\sqrt{\det W\det X}\), maximizes the resulting concave quadratic, and exhibits a single matrix feasible for every \(\beta\) that attains the claimed Holevo value. The accompanying checker confirms the algebra on independent deterministic instances; the proof, not the grid check, establishes the universal claim.

value.rationale: The source uses one isotropic weight to demonstrate MLD–Holevo separation. Since weight matrices encode metrological loss functions, robustness under anisotropic weighting is a natural mathematical and operational question. The theorem completely classifies a full positive-definite block-compatible cone, gives exact gap size, and identifies a sharp optimizer transition, rather than recomputing a single numerical instance.
